text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 434, June 26, 1961 ]
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 113, SERIES OF 1955, WHICH ESTABLISHES THE
CLASSIFICATION OF ROADS
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, Carlos P. Garcia, President of the Philippines, do hereby
amend Item 14, under Quezon City (National Secondary Roads) of Executive Order No. 113, series of 1955,
so as to read as follows:
14.
University Avenue
12.905
13.985
1.08
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and sixty-one,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifteenth.
(SGD.) CARLOS P. GARCIA
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) NATALIO P. CASTILLO
Executive Secretary
